newsitem.title: USA: U.S. zinc output dips in Feb, year-to-date higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. zinc output dips in Feb, year-to-date higher.

text.p: U.S. zinc smelter production fell to 19,726 short tons in February, a shorter month, from 21,636 tons in January, but output in the first two months of the year was up from the 40,212 tons in the same period last year, American Bureau of Metal Statistics said.
The daily average production in February was 705 tons compared to 698 tons in January, and 694 tons in February last year.
Shipments in February totaled 20,032 tons, down from 21,043 tons in January, but year to date shipments are ahead of last year.
Inventories at producer plants totaled 5,999 tons in February compared to 6,929 tons in January.
Total inventory elsewhere in the U.S. in February was 1,173 tons, up from 571 tons in January.
